# Clinical Assessment

This folder covers the evaluation of patient health status using standardized scoring tools, specifically focusing on comorbidity indices like the Charlson Score. It documents instances where strict adherence to these assessment criteria leads to misclassifications, such as when baseline patient groups are confounded by variables like advanced age. The content highlights the practical complexities and discrepancies hospitals face when applying these clinical metrics to specific patient demographics.

## Pages

- [[clinical-assessment|Clinical Assessment]] — Explores the evaluation of patient comorbidity using the Charlson Score, highlighting discrepancies found by Regionshospital Nordjylland where advanced age confounded the baseline "score 0" classification.
